\lemma partialSum-empty {A : AddMonoid} {S : Series A} : partialSum S 0 = 0
\lemma partialSum_1 {A : AddMonoid} {S : Series A} : partialSum S 1 = S 0
\lemma partialSum_suc {A : AddMonoid} {S : Series A} {n : Nat} : partialSum S (suc n) = partialSum S n + S n

\lemma partialSum_+ {A : AbMonoid} {f g : Series A} {N : Nat} : partialSum (\lam n => f n + g n) N = partialSum f N + partialSum g N
\lemma partialSum-split-shifted {A : AddMonoid} {S : Series A} {n q : Nat} : partialSum S (n + q) = partialSum S n + partialSum (\lam k => S (n + k)) q
\lemma partialSum-split {A : AddMonoid} {S : Series A} {n m : Nat} (p : n <= m) : partialSum S m = partialSum S n + midSum S n m
\lemma partialSum-monotone {S : Series ExUpperReal} (S>=0 : \Pi (n : Nat) -> 0 <= S n) {n m : Nat} (p : n <= m) : partialSum S n <= partialSum S m
\lemma partialSum_norm_<= {A : ExPseudoNormedAbGroup} {S : Series A} {N : Nat} : norm (partialSum S N) ExUpperRealAbMonoid.<= partialSum (\lam k => A.norm (S k)) N
\lemma partialSum_<= {A : PosetAddMonoid} {S T : Series A} {n : Nat} (p : \Pi (k : Nat) -> S k <= T k) : partialSum S n <= partialSum T n
\lemma partialSum_hom {A B : AddMonoid} (f : AddMonoidHom A B) {S : Series A} {n : Nat} : f (partialSum S n) = partialSum (\lam i => f (S i)) n
